title: Champions
description:
You both share a set of beliefs, morals, values or maybe a faith
With:__bon1_wi__ (which PC). Your Cause: __bon1_c__

outcomes.text: When you **End the Session** also ask, *"Did we significantly support our cause?" If "Yes", both of you mark 1 XP

pick: **Return the Favor** - When you help or save a relevant NPC, they now support your Cause. Once in the campaign per helped/saved NPC you may request their aid; they will appear as soon as possible and help you with any current predicament you're in.
**You Cannot Kill an Idea** - When you **Face Death** while fighting for your Cause, you may choose to **Go Out in a Blaze of Glory** without dying. Each of you can use this Move once in a campaign.

**United We Stand** - Each of you, once per session, may Aid the other while pursuing your Cause without paying any cost. When either of you **Sense Motive**, you can always ask "Do you believe in my cause?" no matter the result.

title: Comrades in Arms
description:
You support each other through fights and their aftermaths
With:__bon2_wi__ (which PC)

outcomes.text: When you Aid your bondmate when they **Trade Blows**, you may choose one (or none):
bullets: Suffer 1 dmg **piercing** instead of another **Aid A PC** cost
Instead of granting **adv** to their roll, you may add your dmg to theirs. This dmg is still affected by min and max choices

pick: **Let It All Out** - When you **Comfort or Support** your bondmate by dueling, brawling, or fighting them, they either choose an extra option or mark 1 XP (their choice).
**Killer Combo** - When you **Trade Blows** with your bondmate's Aid, on a 12+ make an additional choice from the 10+ list.

**Training Exercise** - When you **Make Camp**, you and your bondmate can choose the same Condition together. Until you next **Make Camp**, you both ignore penalties from that Condition. Condition: __bon2_c__

title: Enthusiasts
description:
You share a passion for a topic, hobby, craft, or similar
Shared Interest: __bon3_si:e.g. cooking, secret history, magic, arena fights, political rumors, birds__

outcomes.text: Once per session, when you discover something new related to your Interest, clear a Condition. If your bondmate is present for the discovery, or when you tell/show them later, choose one from **Comfort or Support**.

pick: **Paired Project** - When you **Enjoy Downtime**, you may begin working together on a project related to your Shared Interest. Say what it is, and the GM will give you 1-4 requirements (similar to **Perform a Ritual**). When you meet the requirements, you finish the project and each mark 1 Depth with each other (in addition to the project's effects). When you **Enjoy Downtime** with a paired project already underway, together you may ask the GM any one question about it.
**Specialists** - When you **Defy Danger** in direct relation to your Shared Interest, ignore penalties from Conditions.

**Great Minds** - When you **Spout Lore** about your Interest, if your fellow enthusiast could answer yes to a question, then you can too, even if they aren't nearby. On a 12+ they may answer instead of the GM.

title: True Lovers
description:
You both share a rare and powerful reciprocated love
With:__bon4_wi__ (which PC)

outcomes.text: Once per session each of you can ask the other, *"Are you thinking about me right now?"* If "Yes", then the responder can **Aid** the asker as if they were in close proximity, with no cost.

pick: **Handfasting** - When you **both commit to a lifelong partnership**, each of you can now use Always on My Mind a number of times per session equal to your current Depth with your lover (instead of once, min 1).
**Let Me Tell You All About Them** - When you **wax poetically about your lover to an NPC**, you can **Pull Strings**+your Depth with your lover (instead of +CHA).

**Together Forever** - When **either of you dies**, the GM will tell the other how to bring you back to life. At the end of the next session (not this one), if you haven't revived your lover, you follow them in death.

title: Mentor & Ward
description:
One protects and guides the other through life and its dangers
With:__bon5_wi__ (which PC), I am the __bon5_role:Mentor/Ward__

outcomes.text: Once per session, when **the Mentor gives advice or guidance to the Ward**, the Mentor says what the Ward should do. If the Ward accepts, their first roll in pursuit of it has **adv**. If the Ward rejects it, the Mentor marks a Condition but the Ward clears one. Either way, if the Ward later achieves it, the Ward marks 1 XP and the Mentor clears a Condition.

pick: **The Sincerest Form of Flattery** - When the Mentor **Sense Motive** the Ward, they may always ask one additional question, even if they're Sensing another. When **the Ward imitates a mannerism or ability from the Mentor**, the Ward may mark a Condition to gain access to one of the Mentor's Moves for the rest of the scene (Ward's call which Move).
**Just Like We Practiced** - Once per session each, the Mentor and Ward can **Aid** the other without any cost or risk.

**Heroic Sacrifice** - When the Ward would **Face Death**, the Mentor may take their place, clearing a Condition (and joining the scene if they were absent). When the Mentor dies, they can give the Ward a final word of guidance, either here and now or based on their last conversation. From now until they see the Mentor again (if ever), when the Ward **End the Session** having followed that guidance, they mark 1 XP.

title: Rivals
description:
Each of you refuses to be outdone by the other
With:__bon6_wi__ (which PC)

outcomes.text:
When you **start each session**, neither of you has the Upper Hand. When you **End the Session**, whoever has the Upper Hand marks 1 XP. Between the two of you, only one can have the Upper Hand at a time.

When you **pull off an impressive feat or dangerous trick**, ask your rival if they agree. If they do, gain the Upper Hand. If they don't, either gain **adv** on your next roll or erase 1 Depth with them to gain the Upper Hand anyways (your call).

pick: **Try to Keep Up** - When you **gain the Upper Hand**, you may taunt your rival to clear a Condition. If you do, they gain **adv** on their next roll.
**That Only Counts as One** - Once per session, when you **admit that your rival went above and beyond or did the impossible**, they may make one choice from **Comfort or Support**.

**I Can Do That** - When you **Aid your rival by copying their actions**, instead of giving them **adv** you may roll at the same time with your own Stat (or other questions, or similar). If your result is higher, they can use it instead and you gain the Upper Hand.

title: Siblings
description:
You know each other more than most... For better and for worse
With:__bon7_wi__ (which PC)

outcomes.text: When your sibling is about to **mark a Condition or suffer dmg**, if it makes sense in the fiction, you can mark the Condition or suffer the dmg instead.

pick: **Shared Past** - When you **Comfort or Support** your sibling, you can also ask *"Did we talk about a happy memory we share?"*
**I Carry Your Heart with Me** - When **your sibling dies**, they choose one of their Advanced Moves; you can now use it, even after you erase this Bond.
**Push Your Buttons** - When you **try and convince your sibling to do something they don't want to**, they can clear a Condition if they reluctantly go along—or mark a Condition if they don't.

title: Mystical Vessel
description: **Special:** This Bond can only be gained from the move **Living Saint** within the Cleric's Oracle Path. While other Bonds are between two PCs, this is between a PC and their deity (controlled by the GM).

outcomes.text:
When you **Make Camp** with 3 Depth with your deity, you **Forge a Bond** with them. They don't track Depth with you.

When you mark Depth with your deity, you may mark a Condition to mark one more Depth.

When you **Invoke the Divine**, after the roll you may spend 1 Depth to treat a 6- as a 7-9, or a 7-9 as a 10+.

pick: **Transfiguration** - Choose a feature associated with your deity (e.g. rending claws, sapphire wings, all-seeing third eye). Your deity bestows this gift upon you. Work with your GM to decide what it looks like, when it manifests, and what you might do with it.

**Thaumaturgy** - When you petition your deity to perform a great wonder that pertains to their domains, treat it as **Perform a Ritual**, but after the GM tells you the requirements, you may spend Depth with your deity 1-for-1 to negate them.

**Apotheosis** - You learn your deity's greatest secret and how to use it. Choose the effect its use will have, or create a new one, then work with the GM to define the secret and how to unleash it.
- It will destroy or imprison your deity
- You will ascend to become a deity yourself; retire your character
- You can fundamentally alter the world in a way related to your deity's domains

After you unleash this secret, erase this Bond. You can never take it again with this deity.

How does this affect your view of your deity? Are they aware that you know their secret?
